label: Drawer

props.name: container
props.description: Portal mount target; defaults to document.body.

props.name: showBackdrop
props.description: Controls the backdrop fill; the outside click area remains active.

props.name: transition
props.description: Enter and exit animation durations in milliseconds.

accessibility.rule: Expose dialog semantics (role=dialog, aria-modal) on the drawer surface.
Associate a title/description for accessible naming.

notes: Events (onClose, onOpenChange, onBackdropClick, onEscapeKeyDown) are framework-specific and omitted.
Drawer renders its portal, overlay, and dialog surface internally.
